title: Scenario 5: Visa 13.6 — Credit Not Processed (Refund Already Issued)
description: Guest cancelled inside the free-cancellation window and the hotel refunded $412.00, but the cardholder disputed before the credit posted. The winning exhibit is the refund credit receipt.

guide.purpose: Credit-not-processed dispute where the hotel already refunded the full amount.
steps: Upload the Visa 13.6 notice and folio.
Verify refund amount $412.00, refund date, reference RF-884120-6610, cancellation timestamp, and cancellation number.
Upload policy, communications, and refund receipt evidence; record refund amount/reference in Probative details.
Draft, approve, compile, and inspect the closing request.
expected: Amount proof identifies the cardholder as already made whole.
Executive summary and closing request denial of double recovery, not a generic reversal request.
Refund receipt is a dispositive exhibit.
